rss: Energy bills to rise by 26% from January after gas prices surge
title: Energy Bills to Jump 26%
story: Energy bills are going up! Starting in January, families will pay more for their electricity. This means using less energy at home might save money.
storyBig: Gas prices have surged, leading to a projected 26% increase in energy bills from January. Consumers will need to manage energy consumption carefully to mitigate these rising costs.
think: How can you save energy at home to help your family?
bull: Using less energy can help the planet.
bear: Higher bills might mean less money for other fun things.

rss: Millions of people to see average monthly mortgage payments rise by £100
title: Home Costs Going Up
story: More people will have to pay extra for their homes each month. It's like when your piggy bank gets a bit lighter!
storyBig: Millions of homeowners are facing increased monthly payments as their mortgage rates adjust. This will tighten household budgets and may affect spending in other areas.
think: What might families do to adjust their budgets when bills go up?
bull: Learning to save money is a fun challenge!
bear: Families might have less money for treats and toys.
